Bangladesh need to be careful. Yes, they are effectively 122/3 and have only one day left but you never know. 98 overs are scheduled and if they lose concentration, they might end up even losing the Test, just like Pakistan did, a month ago. What can we expect? A result or a draw? Join us at 0300 IST (2130 GMT, previous day) to find out how Day 5 unfolds. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

The Kiwis had to work hard today as well but they did well. They saw off the first hour but then lost their way before Watling and Santner led a nice recovery. Wagner's cameo helped the Kiwis get past 500 and bring the deficit down to 56. And in the end, they will be buoyed with the fact that they got 3 wickets towards the close.

STUMPS ON DAY 4. A sad way to end the day for Bangladesh. They were going along nicely until the cramp happened to Imrul Kayes and his departure led to three quick wickets. Bangladesh will hope that he comes out to bat tomorrow as they are in a precarious position now with the lead just 122.
